newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Wacker-Chemie unit in 800 mln mark wafer project.
newsitem.headline: Wacker-Chemie unit in 800 mln mark wafer project.

text.p: Wacker Siltronic AG, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Munich-based Wacker-Chemie, will invest 800 million marks in a silicon wafer plant in Singapore and related capacity in Germany, Wacker-Chemie said on Tuesday.
It said in a statement the Singapore new plant would produce hyperpure silicon wafers, with related upstream capacity in Freiberg, Germany.
The Singapore plant would have a monthly capacity of 250,000 200-mm wafers, and 640 employees. Construction work would start in August 1997 and commissioning would be in mid-1999, the statement said.
It said around a quarter of the total expenditure would go to Freiberg, where Wacker would create 140 additional jobs.
Wacker-Chemie's semiconductors division forecasts sales of 1.7 billion marks for 1997.
